title: GSLM2: Multi-Stream Speech Representation Learning and Generative Spoken Language Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.01143v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative spoken language models (SLMs) offer a route to learning linguistic structure purely from speech, yet they lag far behind text-based models in both capability and data scaling efficiency. We identify two bottlenecks underlying this gap: the limited linguistic quality of existing speech units and the reliance on a single stream of discrete units to represent speech. Multiple codebooks are widely used to encode acoustic features but rarely to represent speech semantics. We present GSLM2, which learns and models complementary properties of speech at multiple levels of abstraction. Its encoder, SpidR 2.0, uses self-supervised learning with differentiable prediction heads to induce high-quality discrete units at multiple levels. A multi-stream SLM then jointly models these units using a shared temporal backbone, stream-specific predictors, and an autoregressive head that captures cross-stream dependencies. Across training data sizes

translated_title: GSLM2：多流语音表示学习与生成式口语语言建模
translated_abstract: 生成式口语语言模型（SLM）为纯粹从语音中学习语言结构提供了一条途径，但其在能力和数据扩展效率方面都远远落后于基于文本的模型。我们识别出造成这一差距的两个瓶颈：现有语音单元的语言质量有限，以及依赖单一的离散单元流来表示语音。多码本方法被广泛用于编码声学特征，却很少被用于表示语音语义。我们提出了GSLM2，它在多个抽象层次上学习和建模语音的互补特性。其编码器SpidR 2.0使用带有可微分预测头的自监督学习，在多个层次上诱导出高质量的离散单元。随后，一个多流SLM通过共享的时间骨干网络、特定于流的预测器以及捕获跨流依赖关系的自回归头，对这些单元进行联合建模。在各种训练数据规模下（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: GSLM2提出了多流语音表示学习与多流生成式口语语言建模框架，通过SpidR 2.0编码器在多个抽象层次上诱导高质量离散语音单元，并用共享骨干网络联合建模跨流依赖关系，从而弥合语音模型与文本模型之间的差距。
en_tdlr: GSLM2 introduces multi-stream speech representation learning and generative spoken language modeling, using the SpidR 2.0 encoder to induce high-quality discrete units at multiple abstraction levels and jointly modeling cross-stream dependencies, narrowing the gap between speech and text-based language models.
